abstract: Discussed is a mature cystic teratoma that was surgically removed from the left ovary, said teratoma containing lactating mammary tissue of a 30-year-old Japanese lady, primigravida and in her 36th gestation week. The tumor measuring 3 X 3 X 3 cm, was accidently found when she underwent a cesarian section. In the lactating glandular tissue of the teratoma, the application of an anti-alpha-lactalbumin serum revealed diffuse and/or reticular cytoplasmic stainings of almost all the luminal cells and secretory materials. Further, myoepitheliall cells were clearly visualized with anti-actin serum. References are made to 2 other case reports of similar tumoral tissue.
abstract_ja: 妊娠36週の30歳初産婦の帝王切開時に偶然発見された、左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を報告する。腫瘍は3×3×3cmで、授乳期の乳腺組織を含んでいた。腫瘍の授乳期腺組織では、抗α-ラクトアルブミン血清を用いた染色で、ほぼすべての腺腔細胞および分泌物にびまん性または網状の細胞質染色が認められた。また、抗アクチン血清により筋上皮細胞が明瞭に描出された。同様の腫瘍組織に関する他の2件の症例報告についても言及する。
